product.name: Mars Express OMEGA 1.08 um Lambert albedo R1080, Ody et al. (2012), ESA PSA MEX-M-OMEGA-5-DDR-GLOBAL-MAPS-V1.0
product.quantity: I/F / cos(i) at 1.08 um, assuming a Lambertian surface; each sample the average of observations from 2004-01-08 to 2010-08-20 (label)
product.chosen: owner, 2026-09-29: a long-term average, built from OMEGA checked by TES (docs/stories/SS-14.md)

gapFill.source: MGS TES bolometric albedo, Christensen; PDS MGS-M-TES-SPECIAL-V1 global_albedo_8ppd
gapFill.method: TES x (OMEGA / TES) averaged over the surrounding 41 x 41 TES cells (5.1 deg) that OMEGA measured completely; filled pixels keep TES's 7.4 km cells

check.method: 1% of the TES cells OMEGA measured completely, chosen with seed 14, removed from the ratio and predicted

conventions.projection: equirectangular (simple cylindrical); both sources on a 3396.0 km sphere (labels)
conventions.longitude: east-positive; column 0 = -180 deg, last column ends at +180 deg
conventions.values: OMEGA 1.08 um Lambert albedo, stored as byte = 255 sqrt(A / 1.0). Not yet scaled to visible light

source.values: 0 = every source sample OMEGA; 1-255 = the share of the pixel filled from TES, rounded up

formatChoice.rule: smallest albedo at most 6291456 bytes with PSNR >= 42.0 dB over all pixels (the Moon's rule)
